result.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
result.summary: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构造一个闭式 oracle 教师：训练时利用标签与未观测特征值，按各候选特征对下游预测误差的影响排序，再用软目标模仿把该排序蒸馏成预算约束下逐实例决策「获取哪些特征」的可部署策略，并在多模态医学诊断与 AFABench 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「按信息价值排序并蒸馏成获取策略」的监督方式可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK/STOP 决策提供训练线索，且其显式教师便于度量可恢复性；但对象是可数表格特征而非视觉 token，可供核查迁移可行性。
